map.PHQ-9 参考问卷，0~27 分，非诊断量表，异常结果请咨询专业人员。: The PHQ-9 reference questionnaire scores 0-27. It is not a diagnostic scale; if the result is abnormal, please consult a professional.
map.PHQ-9（患者健康问卷抑郁量表，Kroenke 等 2001）共 9 题，评估: The PHQ-9 (Patient Health Questionnaire depression scale, Kroenke et al. 2001) has 9 items that assess how often you have been bothered by the following feelings over the "past two weeks". Each item scores 0-3 (0 = not at all, 1 = several days, 2 = more than half the days, 3 = nearly every day), and adding the 9 items gives a total of 0-27. Reference bands: 0-4 none or very mild, 5-9 mild, 10-14 moderate, 15-19 moderately severe, 20-27 severe. Item 9 concerns thoughts of self-harm; if it scores 1 or more, a safety notice appears. Everything runs in the browser and no answer is uploaded.
map.点选项文字即可作答，也可用键盘 1–4 / ← →: Click the option text to answer; you can also use keys 1-4 / ← →
map.题号速览（点任意题号可回去改答案）: Question number overview (click any number to go back and change that answer)
map.PHQ-9 问的是「过去两周」，不是某一天或一辈子的状态: The PHQ-9 asks about the "past two weeks", not a single day or your whole life
map.每题按被困扰的频率从「完全不会」到「几乎每天」选一档: For each item pick one level by how often you were bothered, from "not at all" to "nearly every day"
map.第 9 题涉及自伤念头，若你确有此想法，请务必查看结果中的安全提示: Item 9 concerns thoughts of self-harm; if you genuinely have such thoughts, be sure to read the safety notice in the result
map.答题进度仅保存在本机浏览器，点「重新测试」即可清空，数据不会上传: Your progress is stored only in this local browser. Click "Restart test" to clear it; no data is uploaded
map.两周情绪筛查：当你或身边人持续两周以上情绪低落、兴趣减退、睡眠或食欲明显变化时，: Two-week mood screen: when you or someone close to you has had low mood, lost interest, or clear changes in sleep or appetite for more than two weeks, use it to judge the severity quickly.
map.复诊随访：正在接受心理咨询或药物治疗时，每隔几周自测一次，观察总分与第 1~8: Follow-up during treatment: while you are in counseling or on medication, test yourself every few weeks and watch the trend of the total and of items 1 to 8.
map.自我觉察：分不清「只是心情不好」还是「可能抑郁」时，用 0~3 的频度打分把模糊: Self-awareness: when you cannot tell "just feeling down" apart from "possibly depressed", scoring the frequency 0-3 turns a vague feeling into a comparable number.
map.快速核对「第 9 题（自伤）单独看」: A quick look at item 9 (self-harm) on its own
map.第 9 题不计入 0~27 的总分分级，但只要≥1 就代表近期出现过自伤或轻生念: Item 9 does not count toward the 0-27 total banding, but a score of 1 or more means thoughts of self-harm or of ending your life have appeared recently. The result section pops up an extra red notice, so please take it seriously and contact a professional or a helpline as soon as possible.
map.PHQ-9 能代替医院诊断吗？: Can the PHQ-9 replace a hospital diagnosis?
map.不能。它是国际通用的筛查量表，用于提示风险与跟踪变化；是否达到抑郁症诊断标准，需: No. It is an internationally used screening scale for flagging risk and tracking change; whether you meet the diagnostic criteria for depression requires a psychiatrist or psychologist to judge through a clinical interview.
map.0~4 无/极轻微，5~9 轻度，10~14 中度，15~19 中重度，20~2: 0-4 none or very mild, 5-9 mild, 10-14 moderate, 15-19 moderately severe, 20-27 severe. The higher the score, the denser the depressive symptoms over the past two weeks.
map.和 SAS（焦虑）有什么区别？: How is it different from SAS (anxiety)?
map.PHQ-9 测「抑郁」核心症状（情绪低落、兴趣、精力），SAS 测「焦虑」核心症: The PHQ-9 measures core "depressive" symptoms (low mood, interest, energy) while SAS measures core "anxiety" symptoms (tension, worry, physical restlessness). The two often co-occur, so testing them together makes sense.
